Hi Elena —

Thanks for the details and for sending the documents. Quick confirmation of our end-to-end steps so there are no surprises: 

1) We will update the billing address and VAT id on your active account so all future invoices include the Partita IVA.
2) Invoices will be emailed to invoices@cumulus-sys.it and we can set a copy to be sent to the AR portal URL you supplied (please confirm if the portal accepts vendor-signed PDFs).
3) For the ledger cutover, our billing calendar closes on the 1st and 15th of each month. Any usage before the change window will appear on the next scheduled invoice — if you need a pro-rated invoice for the cutover date let us know and we can generate one off-cycle.
4) We require a signed remit-change form (received) and a bank instruction confirmation if you want payments routed to a new lockbox/IBAN. If the bank changes, please send a bank confirmation letter (bank stamp or bank-sent email).

Ben, can you please update the account record and queue the remit-change for the billing team? Stephanie, please advise if we need to route this through legal for the entity name swap on our contract.

Elena — I will confirm when changes are live (I expect within 48 hours once Ben updates the account).

Best,
